basic_info.description: Calling all Nature Loving, Urban Dwellers! A beautifully crafted single-family home nestled in the heart of SF. Backing up to open space w/direct access to Mt Davidson Park w/hiking trails, & breathtaking Bay views, both serenity & city life are possible! This charming residence offers approx. 1,777 sq. ft. of thoughtfully redesigned living space. Enter through the brick paved tunnel entry, to the main level w/newly refinished hardwood floors, where you will find a spacious living room w/cozy fireplace, formal dining room, renovated kitchen & family room. Additional features on this level include laundry area, direct access to the backyard & full bath. Upstairs, the home boasts three inviting bedrooms & elegantly renovated & expanded spa like bathroom. The 2 front bedrooms both offer expansive Bay Views & ample closet space, the back bedroom has direct access to the amazing backyard.  The heart of this home is its refreshed kitchen, featuring a designer's touch, new flooring, lighting, quartz counters, painted cabinets, all new hardware, breakfast bar & SS appliances. Step outside to the delightful tiered backyard perfect for entertaining, complete w/2 additional levels for playing or gardening. Last but not least: 2 car SS garage w/power for EV, storage & room for tinkering.
